text:
jordan_sales: FYI HealthSys (enterprise) is requesting a formal commit. Workload: chat (interactive) + ad-hoc embeddings for search. They quoted peaks: 120 rps chat (~800 tokens avg), 60 rps embeddings (batching preferred). SLA: chat p95 <350ms. They require HIPAA. Need guidance: reserved GPUs vs large burst pool?

zoe_runtime: thanks. quick Qs: are chat/embeddings on same model family? customer wants Dedicated or Private because of HIPAA?

jordan_sales: chat = 70B quantized family, embeddings = 2B quantized. They prefer Dedicated with reservation if price aligns.

mike_infra: ballpark math: chat 120*800 = 96k tokens/sec; embeddings 60*routing-equivalent ~90k tokens/sec -> ~186k tokens/sec total. Conservative perf: one A800/80GB does ~4k tokens/sec on 70B quant. Naive reserve = ~47 GPUs. But we must apply batching, kv-prefix caching, and scheduling to reduce that.

san_mlops: recommended approach: 1) reserve baseline for steady-state (60% of expected sustained) -> reserve ~30 GPUs 2) enable burst pool/credits for spikes + autoscale cap to 50 GPUs 3) embeddings: enforce batch size >=32 to reduce overhead. KV caching + prompt normalization can reduce token processing by ~20-35%.

amy_account: from pricing side, customers like: 30 reserved GPUs + 20 burst credits with a monthly soft cap on burst spend. I can model TCO if eng confirms per-GPU throughput numbers.

zoe_runtime: latency is tight. Ops checklist: quantized kernels (int8/4), fused attention kernels, tokenized prompt truncation, and controlled max_context for chat. Autoscale policy suggestion: min_replicas=30, max_replicas=50, prewarm_slots=4 per AZ, scale_trigger_queue=150. Fallback: automatic model failover to a tuned 13B variant if p95 breaches SLA for >3 consecutive minutes.

mike_infra: operational notes: AZ spread for Dedicated pool, eviction tolerance, and reserved instance affinity. Prewarm jobs should run before business hours. We'll produce AZ spread doc and eviction guidance.

san_mlops: action items: A) perf sim using a representative 10-minute trace (we need a sample) B) cost estimate for reserve30+burst20 with capped burst C) autoscale/fallback runbook. I can start perf sim once Jordan uploads trace.

jordan_sales: I'll request a 20k-message anonymized trace and permission for a short load test. Plan: get sample today, perf sim tomorrow, numbers by end of day tomorrow. Tagging @zoe_runtime @mike_infra.

deploy-bot: perf-run queued by san_mlops  job id lt-2026-03-23-18-40 (queued).

amy_account: I'll draft contractual language for burst caps, overage tiers, and a monthly buffer credit. Also include HIPAA / BAA standard clauses and KMS BYOK options.

zoe_runtime: note: include a canary plan for the rollout: start with 10% traffic on reserved pool, monitor p95/throughput for 2 hours, then ramp 30% -> 100%. Also include KV warmup: run small synthetic workload to populate caches. Example warmup cmd: ```for f in top_prompts.jsonl; do curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/internal/warmup -d @${f}; done```

mike_infra: I'll prepare the prewarm schedule and spot-eviction tolerance notes. Deliverable in ~5 hours.

\jaman_sales: thanks all. I'll update when the customer responds. :pray:
